snippet.title: The Shore: Enhanced Edition - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games

The Shore: Enhanced Edition is now available on PlayStation 5. The acclaimed Lovecraftian horror adventure, explore a cursed island, face eldritch entities, and uncover the truth behind a father's desperate search for his missing daughter.
